ayahs.1: Ae imaan wale logo! Allah aur us ke Rasool se aage na badho aur Allah se darte raha karo. Yaqeenan Allah Taala sunne wala, jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.2: Ae imaan walo! Apni aawazen Nabi ki aawaz se oopar na karo aur na un se oonchi aawaz se baat karo jaise aapas mein ek doosre se karte ho, kahin (aisa na ho ke) tumhare aamaal akarat jaayen aur tumhein khabar bhi na ho.
ayahs.3: Beshak jo log Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ke huzoor mein apni aawazen past rakhte hain, yehi woh log hain jin ke dilon ko Allah ne parhezgaari ke liye jaanch liya hai. Un ke liye maghfirat hai aur bada sawaab hai.
ayahs.4: Jo log aap ko hujron ke peechhe se pukaarte hain un mein se aksar (bilkul) be-aql hain.
ayahs.5: Agar yeh log yahan tak sabr karte ke aap khud se nikal kar un ke paas aa jaate to yehi un ke liye behtar hota, aur Allah Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai.
ayahs.6: Ae musalmano! Agar tumhein koi faasiq khabar de to tum us ki achchhi tarah tehqeeq kar liya karo aisa na ho ke nadaani mein kisi qaum ko eeza pahuncha do phir apne kiye par pashemani uthao.
ayahs.7: Aur jaan rakho ke tum mein Allah ke Rasool maujood hain, agar woh tumhara kaha karte rahe bahut umoor mein, to tum mushkil mein pad jaao lekin Allah Taala ne imaan ko tumhare liye mehboob bana diya hai aur ise tumhare dilon mein zeenat de rakhi hai aur kufr ko aur gunaah ko aur nafarmani ko tumhari nigahon mein napasandeeda bana diya hai, yehi log raah-yafta hain.
ayahs.8: Allah ke ehsaan-o-inaam se aur Allah daana aur ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.9: Aur agar musalmanon ki do jamaaten aapas mein lad padhen to un mein mel-milaap kara diya karo. Phir agar un dono mein se ek jamaat doosri jamaat par zyadati kare to tum (sab) us giroh se jo zyadati karta hai lado. Yahan tak ke woh Allah ke hukm ki taraf laut aaye, agar laut aaye to phir insaaf ke saath sulah kara do aur adl karo beshak Allah Taala insaaf karne walon se mohabbat karta hai.
ayahs.10: (Yaad rakho) saare musalman bhai bhai hain pas apne do bhaiyon mein milaap kara diya karo, aur Allah se darte raho taake tum par rahm kiya jaaye.
ayahs.11: Ae imaan walo! Mard doosre mardon ka mazaaq na udaayen mumkin hai ke yeh un se behtar ho aur na auraten auraton ka mazaaq udaayen mumkin hai yeh un se behtar hon, aur aapas mein ek doosre ko aib na lagao aur na kisi ko bure laqab do. Imaan ke baad fisq bura naam hai, aur jo tauba na karen wohi zaalim log hain.
ayahs.12: Ae imaan walo! Bahut badgumaniyon se bacho yaqeen maano ke baaz badgumaniyan gunaah hain. Aur bhed na tatola karo aur na tum mein se koi kisi ki gheebat kare. Kya tum mein se koi bhi apne murda bhai ka gosht khaana pasand karta hai? Tum ko us se ghin aayegi, aur Allah se darte raho, beshak Allah tauba qabool karne wala meharbaan hai.
ayahs.13: Ae logo! Hum ne tum sab ko ek (hi) mard-o-aurat se paida kiya hai aur is liye ke tum aapas mein ek doosre ko pehchaano kunbe aur qabeelay bana diye hain, Allah ke nazdeek tum sab mein ba-izzat woh hai jo sab se zyada darne wala hai. Yaqeen maano ke Allah daana aur ba-khabar hai.
ayahs.14: Dehaati log kehte hain ke hum imaan laaye. Aap keh dijiye ke dar-haqeeqat tum imaan nahin laaye lekin tum yun kaho ke hum Islam laaye (mukhalifat chhod kar mutee ho gaye) halanke abhi tak tumhare dilon mein imaan daakhil hi nahin hua. Tum agar Allah ki aur us ke Rasool ki farmabardari karne lago ge to Allah tumhare aamaal mein se kuchh bhi kam na karega. Beshak Allah bakhshne wala meharbaan hai.
ayahs.15: Momin to woh hain jo Allah aur us ke Rasool par (pakka) imaan laayen phir shak-o-shubha na karen aur apne maal se aur apni jaanon se Allah ki raah mein jihad karte rahen, (apne daawa-e-imaan mein) yehi sachche aur raast-go hain.
ayahs.16: Keh dijiye! Ke kya tum Allah Taala ko apni deendari se aagah kar rahe ho, Allah har us cheez se jo aasmanon mein aur zameen mein hai bakhoobi aagah hai. Aur Allah har cheez ka jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.17: Apne musalman hone ka aap par ihsan jataate hain. Aap keh dijiye ke apne musalman hone ka ihsan mujh par na rakho, balke darasal Allah ka tum par ihsan hai ke us ne tumhein imaan ki hidayat ki agar tum raast-go ho.
ayahs.18: Yaqeen maano ke aasmanon aur zameen ki posheeda baaten Allah khoob jaanta hai. Aur jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho ise Allah khoob dekh raha hai.
